intro.text: A deep trench in Shadesmar's Sea of Souls.

description.text: Local spren call it the great trench. Sailors know it well and prefer to stay in the shallows along its western side.
On the map, it runs from Nohadon's Stairways in the north to Nameless in the south, with a long peninsula holding the lighthouse Abiding Light alongside its southern half.

items.text: Adolin and Shallan's delegation from Urithiru to Lasting Integrity sailed along the shallows beside the trench. Their peakspren crew had special tools for measuring the depth of the beads.
